items.title: Google’s revived nuclear power plant gets $1.9B loan from US government
items.summary: Google said it would bring an Iowa nuclear power plant back from the dead. Now the plant's owner is getting a $1.9 billion loan from the U.S. Energy Department.

items.title: DOE Closes $1.9-Billion Loan to Restart Duane Arnold Nuclear Plant
items.summary: The U.S. Dept. of Energy (DOE) said the agency has closed a loan of as much as $1.9 billion to NextEra Energy to support the restart of the Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa.

items.title: NextEra Energy, DOE Close on $1.9 Billion Loan for Nuclear Power Plant in Iowa
items.summary: NextEra Energy said it reached a deal with the U.S. Department of Energy, closing on a loan of up to $1.9 billion to support the restart of the company’s Duane Arnold Energy Center in Iowa.

items.title: US Loans $1.9 Billion to Restart Shuttered NextEra Nuclear Plant
items.summary: The Trump administration is loaning as much as $1.9 billion to restart a shuttered NextEra Energy Inc. nuclear power plant in Iowa, part of a broader push to revive the US nuclear industry.

items.title: NextEra secures $1.9B DOE loan for Duane Arnold nuclear restart
items.summary: The U.S. Department of Energy under the Trump administration has financed three plant restarts and made other conditional commitments to bring nuclear power online.

items.title: Top M&A Deals In September: Nvidia, Dominion Energy, Nextera Energy, Vertiv In Focus
items.summary: Nvidia’s acquisition of Hugging Face, shareholder approval of the merger of NextEra Energy and Dominion Energy, and Vertiv Holdings’ acquisition of UtilityInnovation Group are in focus this week.
